issues.reason: English original trace is narrowed to 原始谱线 in Chinese. Trace can be a recorded curve/tracing and does not establish a spectroscopic method. Use a modality-neutral 曲线/记录 or make a specific trace type explicit in English, then independently reread the revised pair.

The target noun itself matches the old source, but original milk serum is rendered 原乳血清. Ordinary milk serum is 乳清, while 原乳血清 ambiguously implies raw milk/blood serum. Original Stedman’s lactoserum context does not justify that Chinese wording. Clarify the exact comparator in both languages; do not silently conflate the anti-serum with milk or a modern immune preparation.

Its in The measured rotation was opposite to that of its antimer has no explicit substance antecedent: the grammatical subject is a rotation, which cannot have an enantiomer. Chinese likewise leaves 其 without the compound. State the compound/substance whose optical rotation is compared, then independently review both complete sentences.

reviewMethod: Actual six untruncated complete-source and saved-whole-pair reads, independently source/sense/POS/EN/ZH scrutinized; exact unchanged preview bytes are rebound to the actual published baseline, not described as a second read. Actual independent AI cross-reading, not human verification. These are provisional judgments bound to the exact preview bytes, not a published-baseline D20 lock or release admission. Three complete pairs are held without editing them. All other approved preview pairs still require immutable actual-baseline binding, source/POS policy, deduplication, build and browser QA. Frozen canonical source definitions and old role permissions have not been rewritten. Rare old material labels are not claims of modern accepted molecular identity or efficacy. Bounded original-source checking is not a full scientific literature review. No publisher example was copied; no dose, synthesis, dangerous protocol or medical recommendation was authored.
